BiblicalUsage: Quiet is the word for the stillness of the soul and the silence of the land: Hezekiah's prayer that he would go softly all his years, the watchmen who are never to hold their peace, and the psalmist's cry to God not to keep silence. Quiet can be peace or it can be the silence of a God who seems far away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe quiet is the test of trust: the watchman who will not be silent is the one who believes God hears, and the soul that is quiet before Him is the soul at rest. The quiet soul is the soul that trusts, and the trust is the rest that the world cannot give.
